ranges.source: GolfDB (McNally et al., CVPRW 2019) - p10-p90 of n=1399 hand-annotated tour swings from 246 PGA/LPGA/Champions Tour golfers; replaces the Tour Tempo (Novosel, 2004) 2.7-3.3 estimate, whose floor it confirms but whose ceiling captured only the lower third of the tour distribution (p50 3.39). Derived from event labels only, no video; see benchmarks/golfdb_v1.json and ADR-012

GolfDB (McNally et al., CVPRW 2019) - p90 of n=458 face-on tour swings from 122 golfers, measured by MediaPipe Pose lite at GolfDB's hand-annotated instants; one-sided (lower is better), replacing the 0.5 uncalibrated estimate. Metric definitions v2 (ear midpoint, not nose). Unaffected by the 160x160 pixel-aspect correction, which cancels for an x-distance over an x-scale; see benchmarks/golfdb_v1.json, docs/M4_POSE_BAKEOFF.md and ADR-012

GolfDB (McNally et al., CVPRW 2019) - p90 of n=458 face-on tour swings from 122 golfers, measured by MediaPipe Pose lite at GolfDB's hand-annotated instants; one-sided (lower is better), replacing the 0.6 uncalibrated estimate. Metric definitions v2 (p90 of hip drift, not max; hip visibility gate 0.7). Includes the 160x160 pixel-aspect correction, which moves p90 from 0.30 to 0.28; see benchmarks/golfdb_v1.json, docs/M4_POSE_BAKEOFF.md and ADR-012
